notes.title: Update 2.0 + error fixed
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[b]Error Fix [/b]
So the error that's been coming up for some people where the game will not install properly has now been fixed. If you were previously having this problem, please uninstall the game and reinstall it, it should now install build 2.0. 
For everyone else, just update as per usual. 

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1027128425183465482/1298615041863450624/afterstories_promo_image.png?ex=671a3501&is=6718e381&hm=39555b234357fb880d8f76db5e83afbabe0469e713b87ccce42e21fbfc4d3e81&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=687&height=386[/img]
[h1]Update 2.0[/h1]
People wanted more, well, here we go!
Our most recent update contains the first 4 romance after stories:
1. True Ending
2. Emily's Afterstory
3. Ao's Afterstory (previously released in 1.3)
4. Hong Yang's Afterstory (previously released in 1.3)
Giving players a little snippet into each couple's life after the events of the main game.

If you enjoyed 'I'm a love interest in my childhood friend's reverse harem!!!' then don't forget to leave a review on the game's page. We still haven't reach 10 reviews yet to achieve a rating. 

[h1]Other Games[/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922580/Wrong_Number/][img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1027128425183465482/1298616543567024158/Steam_Announcement_Banner_800x450.png?ex=671a3667&is=6718e4e7&hm=efbdaa71479539518fce6241c34b806f573d4afb8f656298f7e0aa8ae3973fdf&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=687&height=386[/img][/url]
Our next game Wrong Number is releasing on steam next month!!
A short 18+ BL story, set once again in Melbourne, Australia, about a man who befriends a stranger who accidentally calls him one night. 
The demo is available to play now for free.

Until next time,
Happy Gaming

Red

notes.title: Update 1.3.0 - Ao and Hong Yang's After Stories added
notes.content:
[b]Heyo and Hello Everyone![/b]

Update 1.3.0 is now available! Just in time for The Storyteller's Festival.

[i]- Ao's after story is now available [Ending 02]
- Hong Yang's after story is now available [Ending 03]
- Extra sprites for after stories
- Extra music[/i]

Two other after stories are currently in developmental stages; Emily's after story [Ending 01], and Ending 00
